integration_patch: The actual component test path exercised the installed extension with a fresh isolated PyTorch runtime; project-local install leaves the runtime distribution inventory unchanged.
Bundle closure remains wired through the existing artifact exporter and now reports an explicit external-resource error for escaping symlinks.
limitations: Extension uninstall uses --force to remove registered components still referenced by project configuration or source; source and configuration are not rewritten.

Bundle export deliberately rejects distribution files that symlink outside their package root. Host CA stores, OS libraries, datasets, and accelerator drivers must be provided externally; no host file is copied implicitly.
The fresh runtime was Linux x86_64 CPU. Other operating systems, accelerators, and native shared-library dependency closure still need release-platform evidence.
